title: Vertical Integration and Cream Skimming of Profitable Referrals: The Case of Hospital-Owned Skilled Nursing Facilities
title_zh: 纵向整合与盈利转诊的“撇脂”行为：以医院自营专业护理机构为例
authors: David Cutler, Leemore Dafny, David C. Grabowski, Steven Lee, Christopher Ody
abstract: We examine whether vertical integration of hospitals and skilled nursing facilities (SNFs) could lessen competition by foreclosing rival SNFs’ access to lucrative referrals. We find that it could: Among integrated providers, a 1 percent increase in SNF reimbursement for a given patient discharged from the upstream hospital increases the self-referral rate to the hospital’s downstream SNF(s) by 1.8 percent. We find no evidence of offsetting benefits for patients and payers: These increased self-referrals have an imprecisely estimated zero effect on patient outcomes and Medicare spending. (JEL G34, I11, I13, J14, L14, L22)
abstract_zh: 本文考察了医院与专业护理机构（SNFs）的纵向整合是否可能通过阻断竞争性SNFs获取高利润转诊渠道而削弱市场竞争。研究发现确实存在此效应：在整合型医疗服务提供者中，上游医院出院患者的SNF报销比例每增加1%，该医院向下游自有SNF的自我转诊率将提升1.8%。未发现对患者及支付方存在补偿性收益的证据：这些增加的自我转诊对患者预后及医保支出的影响呈现不精确的零效应。（JEL分类号：G34, I11, I13, J14, L14, L22）

title: Quand les distinctions de la Légion d’honneur française font fluctuer les cours boursiers : un signal du marché indiquant l’accès aux cercles politiques
title_zh: 法国荣誉军团勋章授勋引发股价波动：市场信号揭示政治圈层准入
authors: Stéphane Benveniste, Renaud Coulomb, Marc Sangnier
abstract: Les distinctions d’État sont conçues comme des symboles de mérite et de reconnaissance publique. Mais elles peuvent également véhiculer des informations ayant une valeur économique. Cet article explore la valeur de marché de la Légion d’honneur. Lorsque des administrateurs de sociétés françaises cotées en bourse reçoivent cette distinction, le cours des actions de leur entreprise augmente. Cette réaction du marché concerne principalement les administrateurs qui, avant la remise de la distinction, n’avaient aucun lien scolaire observable publiquement avec des membres du gouvernement en place. Cette tendance suggère que les distinctions d’État peuvent fournir aux investisseurs de nouvelles informations sur l’accès potentiel d’un dirigeant aux décideurs politiques.
abstract_zh: 国家荣誉勋章被视为功绩与公众认可的象征，但它们也可能传递具有经济价值的信息。本文探讨了法国荣誉军团勋章的市场价值。当法国上市公司的董事获得这一荣誉时，其所在公司的股价会上涨。这种市场反应主要集中于那些在授勋前与现任政府成员之间不存在公开可观察的校友关系的董事。这一趋势表明，国家荣誉勋章能够为投资者提供关于企业高管接触政策制定者潜在渠道的新信息。

title: Bundling Trades In Over-The-Counter Markets
title_zh: 场外交易市场中的捆绑交易
authors: Jason Allen, Milena Wittwer
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In the canonical view of over-the-counter markets, dealers intermediate single-asset trades one at a time. We study a complementary role: when investors trade several assets at once, dealers absorb the joint position into inventory, insuring against execution risk. Using data on the near-universe of Canadian fixed-income trades, we find that bundled transactions account for 20 percent of investor volume. We develop a simple model of why, when, where, and at what prices investors bundle, and use it to explain three patterns. Switches—a purchase paired with a sale—transact at a discount, while uni-directional bundles—all buys or sells—transact at a premium, because a switch’s legs hedge within the dealer’s book while a uni-directional bundle’s compound. Bundling rises with volatility, when insurance against execution risk is most valuable, and the two types sort asymmetrically across bilateral and electronic venues. Together, these patterns reveal a dimension of intermediation the single-asset view overlooks, and one likely to grow in importance.
abstract_zh: 在场外交易市场的经典视角中，交易商一次仅中介单一资产交易。我们研究了一个互补性角色：当投资者同时交易多种资产时，交易商将联合头寸纳入库存，以此对冲执行风险。利用加拿大固定收益市场近乎全量交易数据，我们发现捆绑交易占投资者交易量的20%。我们构建了一个简约模型，解释投资者为何、何时、何地以及以何种价格进行捆绑交易，并以此阐明三种模式。配对交易（买入与卖出组合）以折价成交，而单向捆绑（全买或全卖）则以溢价成交，原因在于配对交易的各腿在交易商账簿内对冲风险，而单向捆绑的各腿则叠加风险。当执行风险对冲价值最高时，捆绑交易随波动率上升而增加，且两类交易在双边与电子交易平台间呈现非对称分布。这些模式共同揭示了单一资产视角所忽视的中介维度，且该维度的重要性预计将持续增长。

title: Disentangling the Effects of the 2018–2019 Tariffs on a Globally Connected U.S. Manufacturing Sector
title_zh: 解析2018-2019年关税对全球关联的美国制造业的影响
authors: Aaron Flaaen, Justin Pierce
abstract: This paper estimates the relationship between the U.S. tariff increases of 2018–2019 and outcomes in domestic manufacturing. Despite being intended to boost manufacturing activity, we find U.S. industries more exposed to tariff increases experience relative reductions in employment, as a small positive effect from import protection is offset by larger negative effects from rising input costs and retaliatory tariffs. Higher tariffs are also associated with relative increases in producer prices due to rising input costs. Last, we document broader labor market impacts, as counties more exposed to rising tariffs exhibit relative increases in unemployment and declines in labor force participation.
abstract_zh: 本文估算了2018-2019年美国关税上调与国内制造业产出之间的关系。尽管关税上调旨在促进制造业活动，但我们发现，受关税上调影响更大的美国行业反而经历了相对就业减少，这是因为进口保护带来的微弱正面效应被投入成本上升和报复性关税带来的更大负面效应所抵消。由于投入成本上升，更高的关税还与生产者价格相对上涨相关。最后，我们记录了更广泛的劳动力市场影响：受关税上调影响更大的县出现了失业率相对上升和劳动参与率下降的现象。

title: The Economic Impact of the USAID Shutdown
title_zh: 美国国际开发署关闭的经济影响
authors: Nicolini, Marcella, Sabatini, Fabio
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: On 28 January 2025 the second Trump administration issued a blanket stop-work order on the United States Agency for International Development (USAID), terminating the largest national bilateral aid programme worldwide. We use this natural experiment to estimate the impact of the aid cut on two outcomes in Africa: local economic activity, measured through nighttime light radiance around USAID project sites; and acute food insecurity, measured through the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) at the subnational level. First, the cessation of USAID activities produced a sharp and significant decline in nighttime light radiance within 500 m to 10 km of project sites, attenuating monotonically and undetectable at 25 km. Second, areas more exposed to USAID humanitarian assistance saw relative increases in population in IPC Phase 3 (Crisis) or worse and Phase 4 (Emergency), with effects building over the first post-shock year, amplified in higher-vulnerability regions and approximately fourteen times larger in less democratic countries. Third, both effects are driven by humanitarian-aid cuts; the nightlight effect is also driven by productive-sector cuts.
abstract_zh: 2025年1月28日，第二届特朗普政府发布全面停工令，叫停美国国际开发署（USAID）的所有工作，终止了全球规模最大的双边援助项目。我们利用这一自然实验，评估援助削减对非洲两项结果的影响：一是以USAID项目点周边夜间灯光亮度衡量的地方经济活动；二是以次国家级综合粮食安全阶段分类（IPC）衡量的严重粮食不安全状况。首先，USAID活动的停止导致项目点周边500米至10公里范围内夜间灯光亮度急剧且显著下降，该效应随距离单调衰减，至25公里处已无法检测。其次，在更依赖USAID人道主义援助的地区，处于IPC第三阶段（危机）或更糟阶段以及第四阶段（紧急）的人口比例相对上升，该效应在冲击后第一年内持续累积，在高脆弱性地区被放大，且在民主程度较低的国家中约高出十四倍。第三，上述两种效应均由人道主义援助削减驱动；夜间灯光效应还受到生产部门援助削减的影响。

title: Did the outbreak of COVID‐19 and individual exposure to it increase ingroup bias in the USA? An experimental investigation of interethnic trust
title_zh: COVID-19疫情爆发及个体暴露程度是否加剧了美国的内群体偏见？一项关于族裔间信任的实验研究
authors: Gianluca Grimalda, Fabrice Murtin, David Pipke, Louis Putterman, Matthias Sutter
abstract: Pathogen‐stress and terror‐management theories predict that lethal epidemics heighten parochial cooperation. We test this prediction experimentally in two nationally representative US samples surveyed before and at the onset of the COVID‐19 pandemic. We compare trust and expected trustworthiness across the two waves in monetarily incentivized trust games involving non‐Hispanic Whites, African Americans and Hispanics. We find significant ingroup favouritism in both waves. However, the aggregate ingroup premium fell by about one‐half between waves. This decline was concentrated among left‐leaning and moderate respondents. While non‐Hispanic Whites tended to reduce their ingroup bias in expected trustworthiness, the opposite was found for African Americans. Respondents more exposed to COVID‐19 displayed higher intergroup trust, altruism and expected trustworthiness than others. These results contradict the hypothesis that lethal epidemics intensify parochialism, also suggesting that the response may be diversified across groups.
abstract_zh: 病原体应激与恐怖管理理论预测，致命性流行病会加剧群体内合作。我们通过两项具有全国代表性的美国样本（分别在COVID-19疫情爆发前后进行调查）对这一预测进行了实验检验。我们比较了涉及非西班牙裔白人、非洲裔美国人和西班牙裔的货币激励信任博弈中两轮调查的信任与预期可信度。研究发现两轮调查均存在显著的群体内偏袒现象。然而，群体内溢价的总量在两轮调查间下降了约一半，这一下降主要集中在左倾和温和派受访者中。非西班牙裔白人倾向于降低其在预期可信度方面的群体内偏见，而非洲裔美国人则呈现相反趋势。相较于其他受访者，更易接触COVID-19的受访者表现出更高的群体间信任、利他主义和预期可信度。这些结果与致命性流行病会加剧群体内偏见的假设相矛盾，同时表明不同群体的反应可能存在差异。

title: Unintended Environmental Consequences of Capital Goods Imports: Evidence From China
title_zh: 资本品进口的非预期环境后果：来自中国的证据
authors: Angdi Lu, Jiang Zhang, Jie Li, Qiangyuan Chen, Jia Cao
abstract: This paper examines the environmental consequences of capital goods imports, employing China's subsidy policy as a natural experiment. The policy, which provides reimbursement to firms for the cost of imported capital, has an unintended impact on the environmental outcomes of firms. We employ the difference‐in‐differences methodology to distinguish between firms highly expose to the policy as the treatment group and less exposed ones as the control group. The results indicate that the subsidy policy significantly reduces firms' total chemical oxygen demand emissions by 21.2% and their emission intensity by 21.8%, revealing notable unanticipated environmental benefits of the policy. The reduction in emissions is primarily attributable to improvements in the production process rather than post‐production abatement. State‐owned firms and firms with a higher proportion of skilled workers exhibit more pronounced reductions. Additionally, our findings suggest that the import of capital goods fosters green innovation, a crucial mechanism through which the subsidy policy exerts an influence on emission reductions. This study offers insights into the environmental consequences of trade policies and the combined effects of production and innovation strategies in response to non‐environmental incentives.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了资本品进口的环境后果，以中国的补贴政策作为自然实验。该政策为企业进口资本成本提供报销，却意外影响了企业的环境表现。我们采用双重差分法，将受政策影响较大的企业作为处理组，影响较小的企业作为对照组。结果表明，补贴政策显著降低了企业化学需氧量总排放量21.2%，排放强度下降21.8%，揭示了该政策显著且未预期的环境效益。排放减少主要归因于生产过程的改进，而非生产后的末端治理。国有企业及高技能工人比例较高的企业表现出更显著的减排效果。此外，我们的发现表明，资本品进口促进了绿色创新，这是补贴政策影响减排的关键机制。本研究为贸易政策的环境后果以及企业在非环境激励下生产与创新策略的联合效应提供了洞见。

title: Socioeconomic status and gender gaps in educational outcomes across the life course: New distributional evidence from linked census-administrative data
title_zh: 社会经济地位与教育成果性别差异的生命历程变化：基于关联普查行政数据的新分布证据
authors: Nguyen, Ha, Chapman, Bruce, Le, Huong, Royer, Heather, Dearden, Lorraine, Mitrou, Francis
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study uses whole-of-population linked census-administrative data to examine gender gaps in educational outcomes from early primary school through early adulthood in Australia and to assess the contribution of socioeconomic factors to these gaps either at the mean and along the distribution of educational outcomes. Leveraging the richness and large size of the linked data and employing some of the most rigorous empirical approaches in the literature, including mother and twin fixed-effects models, we find that females outperform males as early as ages 5–6 across multiple developmental domains, and that this advantage persists through university. The gender gap in favour of females is larger among lower-performing students. We also find that boys benefit more than girls from growing up in more advantaged families, particularly among academically lower-performing boys. However, this advantage is observed only for outcomes measured in the early years of primary school. By contrast, for outcomes measured at the tertiary level, most indicators of socioeconomic advantage confer stronger benefits to females, especially among individuals at the lower end of the educational attainment distribution. Finally, having ruled out gender differences in birth weight—which favour males—we identify gender differences across siblings in school sector choice and early childhood health conditions, both favouring females, as potential mechanisms underlying these patterns.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用全人口关联普查与行政数据，考察澳大利亚从小学早期至成年早期的教育成果性别差距，并评估社会经济因素在均值及教育成果分布上对这些差距的贡献。借助关联数据的丰富性与大规模特征，并采用文献中最严谨的实证方法（包括母亲固定效应模型和双胞胎固定效应模型），我们发现：早在5-6岁阶段，女性在多个发展领域已优于男性，且这一优势持续至大学阶段。女性优势的性别差距在学业表现较低的学生中更为显著。同时，成长于更优越家庭环境的男孩比女孩获益更多，尤其体现在学业表现较低的男孩群体中——但这一优势仅存在于小学早期阶段的教育成果指标。相比之下，在高等教育阶段，大多数社会经济优势指标对女性更有利，尤其对教育成就分布底端的个体而言。最后，在排除出生体重（男性占优）的性别差异后，我们识别出兄弟姐妹间在学校类型选择及儿童早期健康状况上的性别差异（两者均有利于女性），这些差异构成了上述模式的潜在机制。

title: Can Sanctions Deter Wars? The Russia-Ukraine Case
title_zh: 制裁能否威慑战争？以俄乌冲突为例
authors: Thierry Mayer, Isabelle Mejean, Mathias Thoenig
official: 官方在线 2026-01-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We use the framework of Mayer, Méjean and Thoenig (2025) to study the geopolitical relationship between Russia and Ukraine. The model embeds diplomacy and war within a quantitative trade framework to estimate: (i) the model-implied probability of conflict over time, and (ii) the impact of different sanction regimes on this probability. We first calibrate the model under a war scenario based on data relevant to the post-February 2022 full-scale conflict, and then add counterfactual sanctions to this scenario. We find that the observed Ukraine’s decoupling from Russia after the 2014 annexation of Crimea reduced its economic exposure to war but also increased the likelihood of a full-scale conflict by lowering its opportunity cost of war. Simulation results show that the 2024 sanction package, if credibly announced in 2021 and made contingent on further aggression, would have significantly raised Russia’s cost of war and could have deterred the 2022 invasion.
abstract_zh: 我们运用Mayer、Méjean和Thoenig（2025）的分析框架，研究俄罗斯与乌克兰之间的地缘政治关系。该模型将外交与战争嵌入量化贸易框架，用于估计：（i）模型隐含的冲突概率随时间的变化，以及（ii）不同制裁制度对该概率的影响。我们首先基于2022年2月全面冲突后的相关数据，在战争情景下对模型进行校准，随后在该情景中加入反事实制裁。研究发现，2014年克里米亚被吞并后，乌克兰与俄罗斯的实际脱钩降低了其经济对战争的暴露程度，但同时也因降低了战争的机会成本而增加了全面冲突的可能性。模拟结果表明，若2024年制裁方案能在2021年可信地宣布并设定为取决于进一步侵略行为，将显著提高俄罗斯的战争成本，并可能阻止2022年的入侵。
